name: io.github.cschmertz/deptime
title: DepTime
description: Know what a Python dependency update breaks before you merge it. Offline, free, no AI in the loop.

environmentVariables.name: DEPTIME_OFFLINE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to never touch the network: no index download and no daily update check.

environmentVariables.name: DEPTIME_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Where the index is stored. Defaults to ~/.cache/deptime.
